title: Commands follow their plugin
description: NPC command completion with MythicMobs, Model Engine and LibsDisguises

files.MythicMobs/Mobs/animus.yml:
AnimusMeg:
  Type: ZOMBIE
  Display: 'Knight'
  Skills:
  - model{mid=knight} @self ~onSpawn
  - message{m="<caster.name> greets <trigger.name>"} @trigger ~onInteract
AnimusKing:
  Type: SKELETON
  Display: 'Skeleton King'
  Equipment:
  - GOLDEN_HELMET:4
  - BOW HAND
  Options:
    Glowing: true
  Skills:
  - message{m="The Skeleton King nods at <trigger.name>"} @trigger ~onInteract
  - message{m="<trigger.name> struck the Skeleton King"} @trigger ~onDamaged
  - message{m="The Skeleton King watches the field"} @PlayersInRadius{r=24} ~onTimer:160

beats.caption: Animus with MythicMobs, Model Engine and LibsDisguises

beats.result: model and disguise in the completion, and the mythic command makes the Skeleton King

closing: With the plugins installed, the mythic command makes the NPC
